newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 opens lower, activity seen thin.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 opens lower, activity seen thin.

text.p: Leeading UK shares opened slightly easier on Friday and were expected to continue in lethargic mood as pre-election jitters and fears of rising interest rates capped activity.
London's FTSE 100 index was off 5.2 points at 4,293.7 by 0737 GMT, losers were roughly in a five-to-three majority.
"We've totally decoupled from the Dow," one trader said. "We seem to be stuck around the 4,300 level."
The Dow broke its three-day winning streak on Thursday to finish 21.27 points or 0.32 percent lower at 6,658.60, after jumping 288 points in the previous three sessions.
